evidence.observation: H701 heater temperature reads 437.4 °C, markedly above T702 at 69.8 °C and reboiler T703 at 69.9 °C.
The large discrepancy persists: T701 439.5 °C versus T702 70.3 °C and T703 70.4 °C; these readings do not distinguish actual localized overheating from a temperature-measurement fault.
Pressure and cooling remain near their earlier values: PY23 500.3 mbar, PDI701 0.6 mbar, PDI702 2.9 mbar, and FYI702 6.8.
Column temperatures remain broadly stable and distillate/reflux flows are present; no composition measurement has been supplied.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint and allowable heater temperature, heater power/controller output, and an independent H701 temperature check are needed to distinguish overheating from sensor or readout error; composition measurements and the separation target are needed to judge separation.
